nodes.objective: Produce and verify a reproducible Linux-runnable release containing the integrated game and its required assets.
nodes.completion_contract: Prerequisite: accepted complete game loop. Outcome: a Linux artifact with an explicit supported architecture/runtime, an accessible launch command, controls and troubleshooting instructions, source, tests, and all required assets; no Windows work. Evidence: artifact absolute path or URL, source revision, dependency/build instructions, license information, and clean-directory launch and test logs. Validation: build or assemble the release, extract or install it into a fresh directory, and actually launch that exact artifact through rendering, sound initialization, active gameplay, destruction, and restart. Disclose required system dependencies and any unverified portability limits.
nodes.state_memo: completed: contract validated against referenced artifacts
